svg.title: A nurse is reviewing percussion tones with a nursing student. Which of the following pairings are correct? Select all that apply.
svg.desc: Percussion tones move from flat over dense tissue, to dull over solid organs, to resonant over normal lung, to tympanic over air-filled hollow organs. Hyperresonance in an adult signals excess air trapping, as in emphysema or a pneumothorax, so calling it normal would mean missing a significant finding.

g.text: STUDY HUB / QUESTION MAP
Percussion Tones
Read the situation
A nurse is reviewing percussion tones with
a nursing student. Which of the following
pairings are correct? Select all that
apply.
What fits here
Resonance is heard over normal lung tissue
· Dullness is heard over the liver ·
Tympany is heard over the intestines ·
Flatness is heard over muscle and bone
Why it fits
Percussion tones move from flat over dense
tissue, to dull over solid organs, to
resonant over normal lung, to tympanic
over air-filled hollow organs.
Hyperresonance in an adult signals excess
air trapping, as in emphysema or a
pneumothorax, so calling it normal would
mean missing a significant finding.
